subject: CPPO: channel partner SKU metadata + invoice routing question
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CPPO: channel partner SKU metadata + invoice routing question

Hi team —

Two quick items as we prep the CPPO listing for CloudBridge Resell:

1) SKU / product metadata: attached is our suggested SKU mapping (sku_mapping.xlsx). CloudBridge, can you confirm the final SKUs you want published? We need exact SKU strings to align entitlements and ensure proper billing mapping on activation. If you want us to mirror your internal SKU set we can, but any mismatch will delay marketplace entitlement provisioning.

2) Invoice routing for reseller-split: AWS has a preferred flow for Marketplace CPPO settlement where invoice responsibility and payor entity are explicit on the invoice. Sam — can you confirm if AWS needs the invoice to be issued to CloudBridge's legal entity or to the end-customer with a redistribution note? Also, do we need a separate MOP invoice template for the reseller cut? I attached a draft (draft_mop_invoice_template.pdf) for reference.

Goal: finalize SKUs and invoice flow by end of this week so we can request CPPO activation and listing publish next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: CPPO: channel partner SKU metadata + invoice routing question

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the sheet. Quick answers from our side:

• SKUs: We prefer to reuse our existing SKU namespace (CB-PRD-*) for customer-facing listings to avoid reconciliation work downstream. I've annotated sku_mapping.xlsx with the final SKU column and marked three items where we need your product slug to avoid collision.

• Invoice routing: We require invoices to be issued to CloudBridge LLC (tax ID on file) for the reseller portion. For end-customer receipts, we want the Marketplace charge to show the end-customer as the payor and a redistribution memo that shows our reseller fee.

We can accept your draft MOP invoice but will need an additional line for reseller commission split and our remittance instructions.

Next steps: Can your finance contact take the edited workbook and produce a redlined MOP template? Also proposing a short call with AWS payments to confirm settlement timing.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Ops Lead, CloudBridge Resell
(attachment: sku_mapping.xlsx — annotated)

Ben / team —

Finance reviewed the annotated workbook. Key notes:

1) We can produce a reseller-tailored MOP invoice but AWS requires the marketplace charge to reconcile to the end-customer ID — so our template will include two blocks: Marketplace charge (customer-facing) + Reseller settlement (to CloudBridge).

2) Tax/treatment: We'll add a VAT/Tax line per-region; CloudBridge should confirm their VAT registration numbers for EU deals.

3) Action: Laura, we do need sign-off on the redistribution memo language. Vanessa, I'll drop a calendar invite for Wed 10am PT with Sam (AWS).

I'll attach the redline in the shared drive after legal review.

Subject: Re: CPPO: channel partner SKU metadata + invoice routing question

Thanks all — good thread. Quick confirmations from AWS Marketplaces payments:

• Invoice party: For CPPO we support both flows but recommend issuing the invoice to the end-customer for the Marketplace charge and providing a separate settlement instruction for the reseller cut (CloudBridge). That aligns with our settlement engine and keeps Marketplace reporting intact.

• Timing: Standard settlement window is net30 after the invoice month close. If CloudBridge needs accelerated remittance we can discuss but it will require a separate merchant agreement.

• SKUs: AWS will accept CloudBridge's CB-PRD-* namespace as long as the mapping to our product code is provided at the CPPO request. Please upload the final SKU mapping to the CPPO request form when you submit.

Sam
Sam Jenkins
Marketplace Partner Success — AWS
